service.purpose: Simulated customer-directed storage and recovery only

support_party.label: Scenario Recovery Support One
support_party.service: Simulated maintenance of a recovery marker under Sable Harbor direction

limited_fictional_delegation.basis: Proposed scenario-only future authority; not a 2026 canon delegation

chronology: All event times derive from the independently reviewed branch-specific Boise release availability; delegation, reviewer decision, counterparty acceptance and contract execution precede authorized flow.
limits: Named Sable Harbor contacts are proposed source contacts in 2026, not independently established real signatories or accepted operating officers.
Every delegation, review, counterparty acceptance and contract execution in this specification is fictional 2027 training-world data only.
The exact customer and support parties are scenario-only personas, not real organizations or canon subsidiaries.
Site-provider contracts and provider HIPAA roles are separate; Switch and IDACORE are not automatically BA subcontractors.
No real ePHI, patient payload, external communication, legal advice, audit credit or actual operating history is asserted.

SIM-BAA-CUST-01.scenario_obligation: SHI may receive, maintain and route only the payload-free scenario marker for customer-directed hosting and recovery; no other scenario use or disclosure is permitted.
SHI applies scenario role access, encryption, logging, incident handling and recovery controls to the marker and retains reviewable control records.

SHI alerts the fictional customer contact within 24 scenario-hours after discovering unauthorized marker access, supplies known facts, and updates the record; this is a training SLA, not a legal notice conclusion.

SHI may permit the fictional recovery support party to maintain the marker only after a separate simulated subcontract with restrictions and safeguards at least as protective as these candidate terms.
SHI assists the fictional customer with synthetic access, amendment and accounting requests within five scenario-business-days of receipt.
SHI makes this scenario contract and relevant marker records available to the fictional review authority for a simulated compliance check; no real regulator access is asserted.
At simulated service end, SHI returns or destroys the marker within 30 scenario-days where feasible and protects any retained copy until deletion.

The fictional customer may demand cure of a material scenario term failure within 10 scenario-business-days, suspend routing, or terminate the simulated service; no actual breach or legal conclusion follows.

SIM-BAA-SUB-01.scenario_obligation: The fictional support party may access only the payload-free recovery marker under SHI direction for simulated recovery maintenance; no independent use or disclosure is permitted.
The fictional support party applies scenario role access, encryption, logging and recovery safeguards and supplies SHI reviewable control records.

The fictional support party alerts SHI within 12 scenario-hours after discovering unauthorized marker access, supplies known facts and updates the record; SHI retains the fictional customer-reporting duty.
The fictional support party may delegate marker maintenance only after SHI approval and a further simulated agreement carrying these same restrictions and safeguards.
The fictional support party assists SHI with synthetic customer rights requests within three scenario-business-days of SHI direction.
The fictional support party makes relevant scenario marker records available to SHI for simulated review and to the fictional review authority only through SHI direction.
At simulated support end, the fictional support party returns or destroys the marker within 15 scenario-days where feasible and protects any retained copy until deletion.

SHI may demand cure of a material scenario term failure within five scenario-business-days, suspend support access, or terminate the simulated subcontract; late execution does not cure an earlier route.
